name: Laplacian Pyramid Residual
description: Analyzes Laplacian pyramid residual energy distribution across scales (Burt & Adelson, 1983).
mechanism:
This method applies the Burt-Adelson Laplacian pyramid decomposition to analyze multi-scale residual structures:

1. **Gaussian Pyramid Construction**: The image is iteratively low-pass filtered and downsampled by factor 2 to build a Gaussian pyramid G₀, G₁, ..., Gₙ. Each level captures progressively coarser spatial information.

2. **Laplacian Residual Computation**: Each Laplacian level Lₖ = Gₖ − expand(Gₖ₊₁) captures the band-pass detail lost between consecutive Gaussian levels. These residuals encode edges, textures, and fine structures at each spatial scale.

3. **Cross-Scale Correlation Analysis**: Natural images exhibit characteristic statistical dependencies between Laplacian pyramid levels — adjacent scales show predictable correlation patterns governed by the 1/f power spectrum of natural scenes. AI-generated images often violate these cross-scale relationships.

4. **Kurtosis and Distribution Profiling**: The coefficient distributions at each pyramid level are analyzed. Natural image Laplacian coefficients follow a leptokurtic (heavy-tailed) distribution well modeled by generalized Gaussian. GAN/diffusion artifacts produce deviations from these expected distributions.

5. **Residual Energy Scoring**: The energy (sum of squared coefficients) at each level is computed and compared against natural image statistics. Anomalous energy distributions across scales indicate synthetic generation or manipulation.
parameters: Analysis type: automated statistical\nScore range: 0 (authentic) to 100 (AI-generated)\nMinimum input size: varies by media type
accuracy: Moderate to High — 70-85% accuracy depending on input quality and method combination.
source: Based on peer-reviewed research in digital forensics and AI content detection.
useCase: Used as part of multi-signal analysis pipeline to detect AI-generated content.
strengths:
• Research-backed methodology
• Fast computation time
• Complementary to other detection methods
• Works across different AI generators
limitations: • Accuracy varies with input quality\n• Best used in combination with other methods\n• May require calibration for new AI models
